# (2)
```{r}
library(coda)
# Input the Data
x <- c(-0.86, -0.30, -0.05, 0.73) 
n <- c(5, 5, 5, 5)                
y <- c(0, 1, 3, 5)                

# Log-Posterior Function
log_posterior <- function(alpha, beta) {
  eta   <- alpha + beta * x                     
  theta <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))         
  if (any(theta <= 0 | theta >= 1)) return(-Inf)
  sum(y * log(theta) + (n - y) * log(1 - theta))
}

# Metropolis Algorithm
set.seed(123)    
metropolis_bioassay <- function(n_iter   = 50000,
                                 sigma    = 1.5,      
                                 alpha0   = 0.8,
                                 beta0    = 7.7) {
  samples      <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_iter, ncol = 2)
  colnames(samples) <- c("alpha", "beta")
  
  cur          <- c(alpha0, beta0)
  log_p_cur    <- log_posterior(cur[1], cur[2])
  accept_count <- 0
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    # Random walk proposal (bivariate normal)
    prop      <- cur + rnorm(2, 0, sigma)
    log_p_prop <- log_posterior(prop[1], prop[2])
    
    # Metropolis acceptance step
    if (log(runif(1)) < (log_p_prop - log_p_cur)) {
      cur       <- prop
      log_p_cur <- log_p_prop
      accept_count <- accept_count + 1
    }
    samples[i, ] <- cur
  }
  
  list(samples      = samples,
       accept_rate  = accept_count / n_iter)
}

result     <- metropolis_bioassay(n_iter = 51000, sigma = 1.5)
accept_rate <- result$accept_rate
all_samples <- result$samples
samples     <- all_samples[1001:51000, ]
alpha_samp  <- samples[, "alpha"]
beta_samp   <- samples[, "beta"]
ess_alpha <- effectiveSize(alpha_samp)
ess_beta  <- effectiveSize(beta_samp)

cat("Acceptance Rate:", accept_rate, "\n")
cat("Step size: ", 2, "\n")
cat("Total iterations: ", 51000, "\n")
cat("Effective Sample Size for Alpha:", round(ess_alpha, 2), "\n")
cat("Effective Sample Size for Beta:", round(ess_beta, 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
df_trace <- data.frame(
  iter  = 1:2000,
  alpha = all_samples[1:2000, "alpha"],
  beta  = all_samples[1:2000, "beta"]
)

p_t1 <- ggplot(df_trace, aes(x=iter, y=alpha)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=1000, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x=1050, y=max(df_trace$alpha),
           label="Burn-in end", color="red", size=3, hjust=0) +
  labs(title="Trace Plot: α", x="Iteration", y="α") +
  theme_minimal()

p_t2 <- ggplot(df_trace, aes(x=iter, y=beta)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=1000, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title="Trace Plot: β", x="Iteration", y="β") +
  theme_minimal()

grid.arrange(p_t1, p_t2, ncol=1)
```


# (3)
```{r}
ld50_samples <- -samples[, "alpha"] / samples[, "beta"]

cat("\nSummary of LD50 Posterior:\n")
print(summary(ld50_samples))

ci_ld50 <- quantile(ld50_samples, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
cat("\n95% Credible Interval for LD50:\n")
print(ci_ld50)

hist(ld50_samples, 
     breaks = 50,  
     main = "Posterior Distribution of LD50",
     xlab = "LD50 (Log Dose)", 
     border = "white")
abline(v = mean(ld50_samples), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = "Posterior Mean", col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

plot(samples[, "alpha"], ld50_samples, 
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, alpha = 0.3),
     main = "Scatter Plot: Alpha vs LD50",
     xlab = "Alpha", ylab = "LD50")
```
